description: Every AVer USA manual, spec sheet, and white paper in a local, type-filtered catalog — with spec comparison and link audits no AVer site offers.

novel_features.name: Model spec comparison
novel_features.description: Side-by-side spec fields for two or more AVer models from their datasheets, ready for bid comparisons and RFP tables. Spec fields come from datasheet PDFs extracted by `harvest --with-specs`.

novel_features.name: Single-model spec dump
novel_features.description: One model's full spec fields as clean text or JSON for spec-compliance tables and agent pipelines. Fields come from datasheet PDFs extracted by `harvest --with-specs`.

novel_features.name: Doc link audit
novel_features.description: HEAD-checks every document URL in the catalog and flags 404s and soft-404 shells, caching last-checked status locally.

novel_features.name: Offline job bag
novel_features.description: Batch-download every document for a model into one offline folder with stable <model>-<type> names, with a --dry-run preview. Downloads need entityIds, which `harvest` resolves at sync time.

novel_features.name: What's-new diff
novel_features.description: List documents and products added or updated since the last sync, filterable by age.

novel_features.name: Doc coverage matrix
novel_features.description: Per-model doc-type availability matrix for a category, flagging which models are missing manuals, spec sheets, or white papers.

novel_features.name: Current vs discontinued
novel_features.description: Flag which models AVer lists as discontinued, filterable by category.
